summary: In Level 2, participants gain the knowledge and practical skills required for working with others, including basic healing, distance healing, chakra balancing and the fundamental Reiki symbols.
intro: At its core, Reiki is a spiritual practice that originated in Japan in the early 20th century. The word “Reiki” is a combination of two Japanese words: “rei,” meaning universal, and “ki,” meaning life energy. The belief underlying Reiki is that a universal life force energy flows through all living things, and disruptions or imbalances in this energy can lead to physical or emotional ailments.

Upon successfully completing Reiki Level 1, practitioners become eligible to progress to Level 2. Only those deemed ready for this advancement by the Reiki Master are accepted into the Level 2 class. In Level 2, participants delve deeper into the intricacies of becoming a healer, gaining comprehensive knowledge and practical skills required for working with others. The curriculum expands to encompass a spectrum of healing techniques, including basic healing, distance healing, and chakra balancing.

Throughout Level 2, students are introduced to the fundamental Reiki symbols, powerful tools that enhance and focus the flow of healing energy. These symbols are not just theoretical concepts; they are integrated into practical healing sessions, allowing students to experience their effects firsthand.

policies.title: Important Things to Know before Signing Up
items: Becoming a reiki healer completely depends on an individual’s austerity which can take years.
Reiki is not against medical science. It works together to bring a speedy recovery.
During the reiki practices, one should not indulge in sexual activities.
A true healer is never against medical science, but he/she always works together with it.

If any healer tries to make you believe that reiki healing is above medical science, do not believe the person because both practices work together just as your body needs both legs to make a balance.
Reiki and yoga work well together to achieve great health.
A true reiki healer’s energy speaks (honesty, compassion, respect, love).
Our course certificate confirms you have practiced the reiki under the supervision of an experienced teacher.

We suggest all the practitioners to pursue simple and nutritious diet / early sleep and early wake up / physical exercises / not to eat any kind of meat / take drugs or alcohol. Following the guidelines will help you to experience the depth of reiki practices.
